name: The Wishes
source: You play as an boy, after everything that happened. A new start, A new house. A quieter place. We three live together and we are not really a picture-perfect family. Never were. But somehow, we’re all we’ve got now. I didn’t expect much to change…But I was wrong. Some things don’t stay buried forever. Some feelings… grow when you least expect them to..."​
translation: “在发生了这一切之后，你扮演一个男孩。新的开始，新的房子。一个更安静的地方。我们三个住在一起，并不是一个完美的家庭。从来没有。但不知何故，我们现在就拥有了一切。我没想到会有太大改变……但我错了。有些事情不会永远被埋葬。有些感觉……会在你最意想不到的时候成长……”​
